inference_constraint.description: M8.2 / ADR-016 — design declaration. 'high' = LLM is orchestrator only; every fact in the report originates from a named deterministic MCP tool whose invocation is captured in `trace.tool_calls`.

evidence_image_sha256.description: M8.2b — SHA-256 hex digest of the evidence image computed at session start. Binds the report to the bytes that were triaged. Null when image was unhashable (oversize, non-file, missing); operators may supply offline-computed digest via AGENTROPIX_EVIDENCE_SHA256.

report_seal.description: M8.2a / ADR-016 — HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the canonicalised report JSON. Computed at write time by `cli.py`; verified by reading `<report>.session-key` (mode 0600) alongside the report. Null when the report was written without sealing (test fixtures only).

completion_proofs.description: M8.3d — verifiable completion-promise tokens (e.g. `TIMELINE_GENERATED`, `MEMORY_TRIAGED`). One token per agent that successfully published ≥1 Finding this run. Sorted for diff-stability. Verifiers can fail a run that delivered findings but is missing a required promise.

_source.description: Tool name that produced this finding

evidence_dict.description: W-073 — typed evidence container for cross-modal IOC fusion. Common fields: ip, path, container_path, process, pid, ppid, hash_sha256, registry_key, registry_value, command_line. Memory-side wrappers populate this; disk-side wrappers may add it incrementally. Omitted (or empty object) on findings that haven't migrated.

file_sha256.description: Issue #10 / #11 — lowercase hex SHA-256 of the byte payload backing this finding (e.g. inode bytes for a T1105 staged-binary, dumped VAD bytes for a malfind RWX hit). Omitted when no payload was hashed.

raw_output.description: M8.2c / ADR-016 — bounded snapshot of the tool return value PRE-LLM-summarisation (default 4 KiB; tunable via AGENTROPIX_TRACE_RAW_MAX_BYTES). Lets a defense expert replay the deterministic step. Omitted when capture failed.

counters.description: M6.4 W-060 instrumentation — structured dataflow counters (e.g. jsonl_rows_read, priority_hits_by_family, events_received_by_agent, detectors_fired_by_id) attached to instrumentation records like trace.timeline.counters.

M6.4 W-060 persistence — structured dataflow counters keyed by tool name (e.g. 'trace.timeline.counters' → {jsonl_rows_read, priority_hits_by_family, ...}). Mirrors the per-record counters in tool_calls but indexed for cheap lookup. Present even when tool_calls has error records so counters survive wrapper timeouts.

iterations.description: Per-iteration TrinityResult JSON (Reflexion-lite, SIFT-W-045). One entry per Trinity iteration; dropped_agents powers the iter-1 vs iter-2 demo beat.
